Requires follow-up root-cause analysis of v2.3.1 failures before re-release.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**, so I rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** is open, describing the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the rollback remediation; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up recommended: root-cause analysis of v2.3.1 before any re-release attempt.
